name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Peter in Chains
history: Bishop John Baptist Purcell laid the cornerstone in May 1841 and consecrated the cathedral on 2 November 1845. It was the first large church west of the Allegheny Mountains. The portico was completed in 1855. It became a basilica in 2020.
arch: A Greek Revival temple by Henry Walter, with a white limestone spire rising 224 feet, for decades the tallest structure in Cincinnati.
features: The portico columns are 33 feet high, symbolising the years of Jesus' life.
Italian sculptor Odoardo Fantacchiotti carved two Carrara marble angels for the sanctuary in 1848-49.

look.d: For many decades this spire was the tallest thing in Cincinnati.
One foot for each year of Christ's life.

fun: The name honours St. Peter's imprisonment and miraculous release from chains in Rome.
journal: A Greek temple with a steeple on top. Columns counted in Christ's years.

quiz.q: Why are the portico columns 33 feet tall?
a: For the years of Jesus' life
